x1.description: Shapes: the second corner. Lines and arrows: the end. Tables: the right edge.

color.description: Black, red, green, blue, orange, purple, teal, gray.

fill.description: Fill palette index for rect, ellipse, diamond, triangle, and star; -1 is transparent.

text.description: UTF-8, at most 65536 bytes. Newlines allowed; other control characters are not.

points.description: Pen and highlight: absolute [x, y] pairs. Line and arrow: 1-100 waypoints the route passes through; linked ends still follow their items.

id.description: A unique name for the item, kept in the board file. update_items and delete_items take it, and from, to, and parent can name it.

label.description: Shapes, lines, and arrows: text that belongs to the item and moves with it. A shape centers it and wraps it to fit; a container shows it at its top left; a line or arrow shows it halfway along.

label_size.description: Text size of the label, 7 px per unit; a caption is 3/4 of it. For a table, the cell text size.

from.description: For line and arrow: link the start to this item, given as a board index or an id, or in add_items and replace_items the id of an earlier item in the batch. A linked end stops just outside the item's outline and follows the item when it moves or resizes. Coordinates for a linked end are optional and are recomputed. get_board reports links as board indices.

to.description: Link the end of the line or arrow to this item; see from.

caption.description: Shapes: a smaller gray line under the label.

wrap.description: Text items: wrap lines at this width in world units. 0 does not wrap.

dashed.description: Lines, arrows, and shapes: a dashed stroke, for example for an optional relation.

elbow.description: Lines and arrows: route with right angles. A linked end leaves from the middle of a side.

parent.description: Put the item in a container: a board index or an id, or in add_items and replace_items the id of an earlier item in the batch. Moving the container moves what it holds. get_board reports it as a board index.

rows.description: Tables: rows of cells, each row the same length. The first row is the header and takes the fill. x1 sets the width; the height follows the wrapped text.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Discover the active tab's board (path is null for an Untitled tab), the tab count, collaboration toggle, human revision, busy state, and agent status. Available even when collaboration is off.

tools.name: get_board
tools.description: Inspect the board, current revision, viewport, and items in back-to-front order. Item indices can change after edits: use this revision for update/delete/undo/redo. Coordinates are world units: screen = world * zoom + pan; the panel occupies the left 168 screen pixels. Paginate using next_offset and verify the revision stays the same.

tools.name: add_items
tools.description: Append up to 1000 items in paint order as one undo step. Returns their indices, their bounds [x0, y0, x1, y1], and the new revision. Defaults: black stroke, width 3, no fill. Text size is width * 7. Give items an id to edit them later by name. Shapes take a label and a caption, lines and arrows a label, and lines or arrows link to items with from/to instead of coordinates; linked ends follow the items. parent puts an item in a container. An invalid item names its position and the reason, and nothing changes. Does not save automatically; call save_board when finished.

revision.description: Optional expected revision. Supply with collaboration_epoch when responding to a snapshot.

collaboration_epoch.description: Reject the response if collaboration was toggled since the snapshot.

tools.name: add_graph
tools.description: Lay out a graph and draw it as one undo step: shapes with labels, linked arrows, and dashed group containers. Ranks run right (or down) along the longest path; rank pins a node's position along the flow; nodes in a group sit together. Edges that close a cycle go around the graph. Node ids become item ids. By default the graph goes at (200, 80), or below what is on the board. Returns like add_items.

id.description: The node's item id; edges and later edits use it.

caption.description: A smaller line under the label.

color.description: Default: the fill's hue, else black.

rank.description: Pin the node's position along the flow, counted from 0: the column when direction is right, the row when it is down. Nodes with the same rank sit side by side across the flow. Without it, the rank follows the longest path from a source.

group.description: Nodes with the same group sit in one dashed container named by it, with that id.

from.description: A node id, or the id of an item on the board.

elbow.description: Default: the graph's elbow. An edge that closes a cycle always routes around the graph with elbows.
Route every edge with right angles.

tools.name: update_items
tools.description: Replace items, named by id or by index, as {id, item}, {index, item}, or a complete item that carries its id, atomically as one undo step. Supply COMPLETE item definitions, not patches; an item keeps its id unless the definition names a new one. revision is required when any entry or from/to/parent uses a board index, and optional when everything is named by id. Moving a container moves what it holds, and moving an item moves the line and arrow ends linked to it. Give from/to again to keep a replaced connector linked.

revision.description: The revision from get_board or the last edit. Required when the batch uses a board index.

id.description: The id of the item to replace.

index.description: The board index of the item to replace; needs revision.

anyOf.description: A complete item that names the item to replace by its id, the way add_items takes items.

tools.name: replace_items
tools.description: Swap the whole board for these items as one undo step, for scripts that rebuild a board. Items take the same fields as add_items; from, to, and parent name ids of earlier items in the batch. An empty list clears the board. revision is optional.

tools.name: delete_items
tools.description: Delete items by index, by id, or both, as one undo step. Indices need the current revision; ids do not. Remaining indices shift, so inspect the board again afterwards. Line and arrow ends linked to a deleted item stay where they are, unlinked, and items in a deleted container stay.

ids.description: Item ids. Give ids, indices, or both.

tools.name: undo
tools.description: Undo one action from the shared human/agent history. Requires the current revision.

tools.name: redo
tools.description: Redo one action from the shared human/agent history. Requires the current revision.

tools.name: save_board
tools.description: Atomically save the active tab. Pass path (absolute, or relative to ~/Documents/Paintboard) to save under a new name, as Save As does; an Untitled tab needs it. Refuses a path that another tab has open. Refuses to replace a file that changed on disk since the tab read or saved it, unless overwrite is true.

overwrite.description: Replace the file even when another program saved it since this tab read it.

tools.name: set_view
tools.description: Set pan and zoom to frame the live canvas before export. All three values are required. Does not alter board items or undo history.

tools.name: export_png
tools.description: Write a PNG beside the active tab's board file and return its path and an image preview (up to 32 MiB). With a window it shows the visible canvas; set_view frames it. Headless, it shows every item, fitted. The tab needs a file; call save_board with a path first.

tools.name: export_svg
tools.description: Write an SVG of every item, fitted, beside the active tab's board file and return its path. Needs no OpenGL, so it works headless without an EGL driver. Text embeds the canvas font. The tab needs a file; call save_board with a path first.

tools.name: get_canvas
tools.description: Read an image of the active tab without writing a file. With a window it shows the visible canvas; headless, it shows every item, fitted. Returns revision and collaboration epoch with the image. Requires Collaborate on.

tools.name: list_tabs
tools.description: List the open tabs: index, path (null when Untitled), active, unsaved changes, and item count. Other tools act on the active tab.

tools.name: switch_tab
tools.description: Make another tab active. This changes the revision, so read the board again before editing.

tools.name: new_board
tools.description: Open a new Untitled tab and make it active. Save it with save_board and a path.

tools.name: open_board
tools.description: Open a board file in a new tab and make it active. A missing file starts an empty board with that path. An open file switches to its tab; with reload, its tab loads the file again as one undo step.

reload.description: Load the file again when its tab is open, for example after another program saved it.

tools.name: close_tab
tools.description: Close a tab. A tab with unsaved changes is refused unless discard is true.

tools.name: measure_text
tools.description: Measure text in world units before you place it, to size boxes and center labels. Works without Collaborate.
